cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today, we're continuing our saga of model evaluation, and we're talking about adjusted R squared.
cues.zh: 延續模型評估，今天談調整後 R 平方。

cues.en: Previously, we discussed R squared, which is defined as 1 minus the residual sum of squared divided by the total sum of squared, and R squared is a goodness of fit for our models.
cues.zh: 先前 R 平方定義為 1 減殘差平方和除以總平方和，用來衡量擬合優度。

cues.en: Greater is better.
cues.zh: 越大越好。

cues.en: Just a quick reminder, we mentioned that R squared is between 0 and 1 and that there is no overarching rule of thumb.
cues.zh: 快速提醒，先前說 R 平方介於 0、1，但沒有一體適用的經驗法則。

cues.en: The values really depend on the industry and use case.
cues.zh: 數值取決於產業與使用情境。

cues.en: So, for some industries and use cases, 0.9 might be a great R squared and 0.4 might be a terrible R squared.
cues.zh: 某些產業，0.9 很好、0.4 很差。

cues.en: For other industries and use cases, 0.4 might be a great R squared, so it really depends.
cues.zh: 其他情境可能 0.4 就很好，所以要看情況。

cues.en: However, there is an overarching problem across the board, which is to do with adding new independent variables.
cues.zh: 不過有個共同問題，和新增自變數有關。

cues.en: So let's say we have a linear regression with two independent variables and we decide to add a third one.
cues.zh: 假設線性迴歸有兩個自變數，決定加入第三個。

cues.en: For example, we got new data, a new column of data, or we got...
cues.zh: 例如取得新的一欄資料，或者……

cues.en: We're just trying to explore and see what other variables might be helpful in the explanation in our model.
cues.zh: 正在探索其他有助於模型解釋的變數。

cues.en: So, what happens when we add another variable is that the total sum of squares doesn't change because it only depends on the average of the y actual values
cues.zh: 加入變數時，總平方和不變，因為只取決於實際 y 的平均，

cues.en: and doesn't depend on the y-hat values.
cues.zh: 不取決於 ŷ。

cues.en: But the residual sum of squares will change, and in fact, it will only either decrease or stay the same.
cues.zh: 但殘差平方和會改變，而且只會下降或維持不變。

cues.en: The problem we are facing is that the residual sum of squares will never increase when we try to add another variable.
cues.zh: 問題是，新增變數時，殘差平方和永遠不會上升。

cues.en: And this might not be intuitive at first, so let's talk about it a little bit.
cues.zh: 一開始可能不直覺，稍微解釋。

cues.en: The main reason for this is that we are using the ordinary least squares method to build our models.
cues.zh: 主要因為用普通最小平方法建立模型。

cues.en: And what the ordinary least squares method does is it aims to minimize the residual sum of squares.
cues.zh: 它的目標就是最小化殘差平方和。

cues.en: So, let's try to see this in action.
cues.zh: 看看實際如何發生。

cues.en: When we add this new variable, X3, the ordinary least squared method is going to look for coefficients of b3 that improve the Yi hat predicted values.
cues.zh: 加入新變數 X3，最小平方法會找 B3，改善 ŷ 預測值。

cues.en: As long as it finds a coefficient of b3 where the Yi hat values are better than they were before, closer to the actual values,
cues.zh: 只要找到讓預測更接近實際值的 B3，

cues.en: then the residual sum of squares will improve.
cues.zh: 殘差平方和就會改善。

cues.en: It could improve by a lot if the prediction is much better now, or it could improve by a tiny little bit, even if the prediction is a little bit better.
cues.zh: 預測改善很多，平方和就改善很多；只有一點進步，也會改善一點。

cues.en: Now, in the situation where the ordinary least squares method cannot find a coefficient b3 that improves the predictions,
cues.zh: 如果找不到能改善預測的 B3，

cues.en: like all possible coefficients b3 make the predictions worse, then the ordinary least squared method is just going to be very smart or sneaky, you can call it,
cues.zh: 也就是其他可能的 B3 都讓預測變差，那最小平方法會很聰明，或者說很狡猾，

cues.en: and it's just going to turn b3 into 0.
cues.zh: 直接把 B3 設為 0。

cues.en: It's just going to say, "Okay, we're going to set b3 at 0," and that means even though we technically added an extra variable, it's not participating at all in the predictions
cues.zh: 它會說：「好，B3 設為 0。」即使技術上加了變數，也完全不參與預測，

cues.en: because it's coefficient at 0.
cues.zh: 因為係數是 0。

cues.en: So, in that case, the residual sum of squares won't change.
cues.zh: 這時殘差平方和不變。

cues.en: It will be exactly as it was before.
cues.zh: 與之前完全相同。

cues.en: So, we end up with a situation where we can just keep adding more and more variables that maybe have even nothing to do with our problem at hand.
cues.zh: 因此可以一直加變數，即使可能完全與問題無關。

cues.en: But by virtue of some random correlations, our R squared, in some cases, will be improving, improving, improving.
cues.zh: 靠一些隨機相關性，R 平方可能一直提高。

cues.en: It never gets worse.
cues.zh: 永遠不變差。

cues.en: So the residual sum of squares will decrease.
cues.zh: 殘差平方和下降，

cues.en: That means R squared will increase.
cues.zh: R 平方就上升。

cues.en: And that's a problem because we don't want to end up with models that have lots of variables that have nothing to do with that model that are not really adding a lot of value,
cues.zh: 這是問題，因為不希望模型有一堆無關、沒增加多少價值的變數，

cues.en: but in general, are just increasing R squared.
cues.zh: 只是讓 R 平方上升。

cues.en: So, what is the solution?
cues.zh: 怎麼解決？

cues.en: The solution is a new version of R squared and adjusted R squared, and that's exactly what it's called.
cues.zh: 使用 R 平方的新版本，調整後 R 平方，名稱就是如此。

cues.en: It is calculated with this scary-looking formula.
cues.zh: 用這個看起來可怕的公式計算。

cues.en: But as you'll see from the practical tutorials, we'll find out it's not scary at all and you'll be able to recreate this actually manually.
cues.zh: 但實作會看到，其實不可怕，甚至能自己手算。

cues.en: So here, there are a couple of new parameters.
cues.zh: 有幾個新參數。

cues.en: k is the number of independent variables that are in our model, and n is the sample size.
cues.zh: k 是自變數數量，n 是樣本數。

cues.en: And the important thing here is to look at k.
cues.zh: 重要的是看 k。

cues.en: So, if k increases over here, then the denominator decreases.
cues.zh: k 增加，分母就減少。

cues.en: That means the whole ratio increases.
cues.zh: 整個比值上升。

cues.en: And because it's been subtracted, that means adjusted R squared decreases.
cues.zh: 因為是減掉它，調整後 R 平方就下降。

cues.en: So that's the important point here, that this new formula penalizes us for adding additional variables.
cues.zh: 重點就是新公式會懲罰增加額外變數。

cues.en: So basically it's only worth adding an extra variable if R squared, this original R squared, if it increases substantially enough
cues.zh: 只有原始 R 平方增加得足夠多，

cues.en: that compensates for this penalty, so adding new variables becomes something that has to be justified.
cues.zh: 能補償懲罰時，才值得加變數；新增變數需要合理依據。

cues.en: If it's not justified, then the new variable is not worth adding, and that's what Unadjusted R squared is about.
cues.zh: 不合理就不值得加，這就是調整後 R 平方的用途。

cues.en: It's about making sure that we only add variables when they bring substantial improvement to our model.
cues.zh: 確保只加入能顯著改善模型的變數。

cues.en: So, there we go, that's adjusted R squared.
cues.zh: 這就是調整後 R 平方。

cues.en: Hope you enjoyed this tutorial and I'll see you next time.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡，下次見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
